positive_cases.name: decode_then_invoke_expression
positive_cases.scenario: Script block decoding a placeholder and evaluating it.
positive_cases.rationale: Decoding and dynamic execution selections both match.

positive_cases.name: decode_then_create_scriptblock
positive_cases.scenario: Script block decoding a placeholder and creating a script block from it.
positive_cases.rationale: Decoding and dynamic execution selections both match.

negative_cases.name: decode_to_file
negative_cases.scenario: Script block decoding a placeholder into a file without evaluating it.
negative_cases.rationale: The dynamic execution selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: invoke_literal_command
negative_cases.scenario: Script block evaluating a literal command string.
negative_cases.rationale: The decoding selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: base64_encoding_only
negative_cases.scenario: Script block encoding text for transport.
negative_cases.rationale: Neither selection matches, because encoding is not decoding.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
